verdict.rationale: Semgrep lets users write custom rules that run automatically on push, pull/merge request, and pre-commit events. Matches can then trigger actions: automated PR review comments, autofix via the rule-defined `--autofix` flag, and alerts, notifications, or tickets for findings. However, these actions are tied to code-scan findings rather than a general-purpose event-to-action automation engine, and the notification/ticketing configuration is only mentioned in passing. Missing for 10: a configurable rule-to-arbitrary-action workflow engine, detailed docs on notification/ticket trigger configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered actions.
